hypothesis: A paper-informed threefold increase in fine-tuning learning rates may improve macro-F1 without materially increasing faults classified as normal.
reference_note: Le et al. used Adam, 0.0003 learning rate and batch 64 on InfraredSolarModules with a different architecture. This is a candidate value, not a reproduced result.
budget_note: Measured on this Mac with the same image files, weights and CPU environment. The 48-minute projection is approximate; cap all nine fits at 3600 seconds and stop between epochs.
test_policy: No original validation or test images in cross-validation training. Never evaluate internal test while tuning.
stopping_rule: At most three fold-specific frozen-head fits and six fine-tuning fits; stop any fit after its epoch cap or two non-improving validation macro-F1 epochs; stop all work at the total local time cap.
external_data_policy: Schaefer sUAS is exploratory binary domain-shift evidence and is not used to choose this 12-class learning rate.
